{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Test All

on: workflow_dispatch

env:
  JAVA_VERSION: 21
  JAVA_DISTRIBUTION: zulu

jobs:
  test-android-23:
    name: Test Android
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        api-level: [ 23 ]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: ${{ env.JAVA_DISTRIBUTION }}
          java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 5
        with:
          cache-overwrite-existing: true

      # API 30+ emulators only have x86_64 system images.
      - name: Get AVD info
        uses: ./.github/actions/get-avd-info
        id: avd-info
        with:
          api-level: ${{ matrix.api-level }}

      - name: Enable KVM
        run: |
          echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules
          sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
          sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm

      - name: Run Android tests
        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
        with:
          api-level: ${{ matrix.api-level }}
          arch: ${{ steps.avd-info.outputs.arch }}
          target: ${{ steps.avd-info.outputs.target }}
          profile: pixel # from command 'avdmanager list device'
          ram-size: 2048M
          heap-size: 512M
          disable-animations: true
          script: |
            mv .github/debug.keystore ~/.android
            internal/test_android_23.sh

  test-android-24p:
    name: Test Android
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        api-level: [ 26, 30, 34 ]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: ${{ env.JAVA_DISTRIBUTION }}
          java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 5
        with:
          cache-overwrite-existing: true

      # API 30+ emulators only have x86_64 system images.
      - name: Get AVD info
        uses: ./.github/actions/get-avd-info
        id: avd-info
        with:
          api-level: ${{ matrix.api-level }}

      - name: Enable KVM
        run: |
          echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules
          sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
          sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm

      - name: Run Android tests
        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
        with:
          api-level: ${{ matrix.api-level }}
          arch: ${{ steps.avd-info.outputs.arch }}
          target: ${{ steps.avd-info.outputs.target }}
          profile: pixel # from command 'avdmanager list device'
          ram-size: 2048M
          heap-size: 512M
          disable-animations: true
          script: |
            mv .github/debug.keystore ~/.android
            internal/test_android.sh

  test-ios:
    name: Test iOS
    runs-on: macos-26
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: ${{ env.JAVA_DISTRIBUTION }}
          java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 5
        with:
          cache-overwrite-existing: true

      - name: Run ios test
        run: internal/test_ios.sh

  test-jvm-linux:
    name: Test JVM Linux
    runs-on: macos-26
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: ${{ env.JAVA_DISTRIBUTION }}
          java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 5
        with:
          cache-overwrite-existing: true

      - name: Run jvm test
        run: internal/test_jvm.sh

  test-jvm-macos:
    name: Test JVM macOS
    runs-on: macos-26
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: ${{ env.JAVA_DISTRIBUTION }}
          java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 5
        with:
          cache-overwrite-existing: true

      - name: Run jvm test
        run: internal/test_jvm.sh

  test-jvm-windows:
    name: Test JVM Windows
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: ${{ env.JAVA_DISTRIBUTION }}
          java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 5
        with:
          cache-overwrite-existing: true

      - name: Run jvm test
        run: ./gradlew jvmTest --continue

  test-macos-native:
    name: Test macOS Native
    runs-on: macos-26
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: ${{ env.JAVA_DISTRIBUTION }}
          java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 5
        with:
          cache-overwrite-existing: true

      - name: Run macOS tests
        run: internal/test_macos_native.sh",
  "rationale": "The workflow contains two Android test jobs that use a matrix strategy with `fail-fast: false`. The pattern P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (supported by literature and synthetic experiments) recommends setting `fail-fast: true` to cancel remaining matrix jobs after a failure, saving CI resources. The matrix in `test-android-24p` has three API levels (26, 30, 34); if one fails, the others are likely to fail for the same reason or are not required to all complete for a manual workflow_dispatch run. The change is minimal, preserves test coverage (all API levels still run unless a failure occurs), and does not affect other jobs. Evidence from the pattern catalogue and experiment examples supports this optimization.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-FAIL-FAST", "experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-4bb0552aeb09c242", "experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-b6e04fef7ef24997"]
}
